description: skyplan.com zoominfo.com/c/skyplan-services-ltd/81691062 Skyplan Services Limited is a private, self-funded aviation flight planning and dispatch company founded in 1983 in Calgary, Alberta, Canada, with major operations in Dubai (UAE), China, and Finland, employing ~85 people. It generates estimated annual revenue of ~$7M with zero external investment over its 43-year history. Its flagship Aurora Flight Planning System (SaaS, web-based since 1998 — a global pioneer) covers 24,000+ airports, 450+ aircraft types, and 1,600+ fuel locations worldwide. Services include contract flight planning, international trip support, aviation fuel sales, permits/slots, ground handling, and 24/7 dispatch — saving airlines up to 5% in fuel costs through route optimization. The company is ranked #1 among independent flight planning competitors (Tracxn), led by CEO Mohammad Sami, competing against giants like Jeppesen (Boeing), ARINCDirect (Collins Aerospace), and Lido (Lufthansa Systems).

refako.dk REFAKO ApS (Refako Autodele) is a Danish family-owned truck and trailer parts retailer founded in 1975 in Odense, Denmark, celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2025. It operates 13 stores nationwide with 200,000+ SKUs (290,000 for B2B) and employs 59–70+ people. Annual gross profit is ~26–27M DKK (~$3.7M), but the company has been loss-making for 6 consecutive years (2020–2025), with equity saved by owner injections (16.3M DKK in 2025) after hitting a crisis low of 2.7M in 2022. It turned operationally profitable in 2024 (+0.46M DKK) under new sole owner Klaus Allan Jørgensen (KJ Holding took 100% in May 2024), but slipped back into losses in 2025. Refako is Denmark's only authorized SAF-Holland partner (global leader in trailer axles/suspension) and carries premium brands like WABCO, Knorr-Bremse, JOST, Dinex, and Exide. Customer reputation is excellent — Trustpilot 4.8/5 from 2,695 reviews — with same-day shipping and 30-minute Click & Collect across its store network.

kooltronic.com Kooltronic, Inc. is a private, family-owned manufacturer of enclosure cooling products (air conditioners, heat exchangers, fans) founded in 1956 in Princeton, NJ, now based in Pennington, NJ on a 170,000 sq ft facility powered by 90% solar energy. Owned by the Freedman family since 1970 (President: Barry Freedman), the company generates estimated annual revenue of $35–45M with 58–87 employees (~$650K–$750K revenue per employee — very high for a manufacturer). Kooltronic invented the world's first closed-loop enclosure air conditioner in 1967 and holds a US patent for Hazardous Location AC systems (NEC Class I Div 1&2), giving it a unique market niche. It offers the industry's widest range — 2,000–30,000 BTU/H units across all NEMA ratings — with 100% in-house production, UL-certified testing labs, and ISO 9001:2015 certification.
